words: Make a picture book, one chapter, about 45 seconds long, from Aesop's fable The Lion and the Mouse. Two characters only: a lion and a mouse. Sets and puppets drawn in code (no painted sets).
Host model note: OpenCode headless runs all steps in the single conversation model google-vertex/gemini-3.5-flash without per-subagent model switching; recorded across all models keys per style.md.
look: Warm cut-paper collage picture book with sets and paper puppets drawn entirely in SVG/JS code, forest shade and dappled sunlight, target length about 45 seconds in one chapter (ch01).

illustration.sets: drawn in code, not painted (no image model calls; paint.py must never be reached)

cast.name: Lion
cast.look: golden-ochre paper puppet lion with a full rounded mane, heavy paws, and expressive eyes

cast.name: Mouse
cast.look: small warm-grey paper puppet mouse with big round ears, pink nose, whiskers, and sharp little teeth
